register.reg_long_name: Instruction Region Table Base Register, Privileged (EL1)
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_S1POE2 is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Configuration of the base address for the region of memory that contains the IRT for execution at EL1.

field_description.para: Base address of Instruction Region Table.
Bits [63:6] of the address are the value of this field.
Bits [5:0] of the address are zero.
The least significant bits of this field are RES0, so that the base address of the table is aligned to the size of the table. If the table is smaller than 64B, then the address is aligned to 64B.
Exclude TIndex from the hardware-defined context for CSV2.
This field applies to execution at EL1.
An implementation is permitted to treat this bit as 0, regardless of the programmed value.

field_value_description.para: TIndex is included in the FEAT_CSV2 hardware-defined context.
TIndex is not included in the FEAT_CSV2 hardware-defined context.

field_description.para: This field is permitted to be cached in a PLB.

field_value_description.para: No effect on the interpretation of the IRT nG bit.
For IRT entries reached using this register, the nG bit is treated as 1, regardless of the programmed value.

field_description.para: TIndex width. The effective width of the TIndex field.
Bits of TINDEX_EL1.TIndex above the configured width are treated as zero.
The value 0 means that TIndex is treated as 0.
This field is permitted to be cached in a TLB.
This field is permitted to be cached in a PLB.
Enable POE2 checks for the Exception level EL1.
If the Effective value of TCR2_EL1.POE2F is 0, the Effective value of this field is 0.
This field is permitted to be cached in a TLB.

field_value_description.para: POE2 checks are disabled. The instructions TCHANGEF and TCHANGEB are UNDEFINED.
